description_i18n.it: Showreel da motion designer di 15 secondi su un palco scuro con HUD: esplosione arancione, tipografia cinetica a tempo, griglia di forme che si trasformano, nuvola di punti 3D e card con firma.

query.en: Make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics showreel that proves you are an incredible motion designer — go all out. Dark stage with a camera-style HUD (corner brackets, timecode, 128 BPM beat squares) and one orange accent. Cut on the beat through five techniques: an orange starburst identity, the kinetic words TIMING / WEIGHT / RHYTHM, a morphing shape grid, a rotating 3D point sphere that becomes a torus, and a signature card for the fictional "Studio Kinetik" where the opening dot becomes the full stop.
query.zh-CN: 做一段 15 秒的动效设计作品集快剪，证明你是顶尖的动效设计师，全力以赴。深色舞台配摄影机式 HUD（取景角标、时间码、128 BPM 节拍方块），只用一种橙色强调色。跟着节拍切换五种手法：橙色放射星芒开场、TIMING / WEIGHT / RHYTHM 动态大字、变形的几何网格、由旋转 3D 点云球体变成的圆环，最后落在虚构工作室「Studio Kinetik」的签名卡上，开场的圆点变成句号。
